facts.raw_span: a 1-year history of slow but progressive swelling near her gluteal cleft
denied fevers, chills, pain, drainage, bleeding, or rectal bleeding
a 4 × 4 cm area of swelling just left of the natal cleft at the level of the tip of the coccyx
mild blanching erythema of the overlying skin but no fluctuance, purulence, or visible pilonidal pits
no fluid was obtained
a complex and septated 6 × 4 × 4 cm mass was excised from the subcutaneous tissue near the coccyx
the mass was adherent to subcutaneous fat but did not involve the coccyx or anal sphincter
a high suspicion for abscess
the differential diagnosis at this time included inclusion cyst and soft-tissue tumor
percutaneous aspiration was performed in clinic
a 6-cm vertical incision was made over the lesion in the prone jack-knife position
the specimen was oriented with sutures and sent for permanent pathology

concepts.why: The patient presented with a swelling near the gluteal cleft, which is a common location for pilonidal cysts, and the excised mass was complex and septated, consistent with a pilonidal cyst.
The differential diagnosis included inclusion cyst, and the excised mass was a complex and septated mass in the subcutaneous tissue, which could be consistent with an epidermoid cyst.
The differential diagnosis included soft-tissue tumor, and the excised mass was a complex and septated mass in the subcutaneous tissue, which could be consistent with a soft tissue tumor.
There was a high suspicion for abscess, and the patient underwent percutaneous aspiration, although no fluid was obtained.

rationales.F02: Absence of symptoms like fevers and chills makes abscess less likely.
rationales.F04: Mild blanching erythema without fluctuance or purulence is not typical for abscess.
rationales.F05: No fluid obtained from percutaneous aspiration strongly rules out abscess.
rationales.F06: Complex and septated mass is more suggestive of soft tissue tumor than abscess or simple cysts.
rationales.F08: High suspicion for abscess based on clinical presentation.

frontier_selector.rationale: The location near the gluteal cleft and the characteristics of the excised mass support Pilonidal cyst, despite the absence of visible pilonidal pits.
